model_claims.text: `get_latex_string()` emitted header and cell text verbatim in both the simple and the formatted path, so any LaTeX special character in the data either broke compilation or silently changed the table.

model_claims.text: A raw `&` splits the cell into extra columns.
model_claims.source_quote: - a raw `&` splits the cell into extra columns,

model_claims.text: The fix escapes the ten LaTeX specials (`\ & % $ # _ { } ~ ^`) in headers and data cells of both emitters via a single-pass `re.sub` with a lookup table — backslash maps to `\textbackslash{}` and is handled in the same pass, so escapes inserted by the substitution are never re-escaped.
